summary: The E‑Rate Management Professionals Association, Inc. supports a definition of consultant, consultant registration, annual certification by consulting firms, annual training, and a written letter of agency with every client. E‑MPA asks the Commission to measure each requirement by its burden on applicants and its marginal gain in program integrity. The text discusses various provisions related to E-Rate, including consultant registration, certification, and reporting requirements. It supports individual consultant registration and provides a description of the proposed system, including the use of a federal identity-proofing service and the requirement for consultants to provide their information on request. The text discusses the proposed FCC regulations on E-Rate and CIPA, including the proposed prohibition on percentage-based consultant fees.
